analogy.rationale: Hedgehog pathway modulators act on Smoothened or downstream GLI, so GLI antagonists and smoothened receptor antagonists should produce the most similar transcriptional responses; because these cell lines have low Hedgehog pathway activity, the overall response is expected to be weak, with other nuclear receptor agonists serving only as low-similarity comparators.
